dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is this all the mighty Fatui are capable of?

dialogues.speaker: Veroslava
dialogues.text: Tsk, is "way too sassy" part of our recruitment profile nowadays...? Wait a sec — you're not one of the new recruits we just brought in!

dialogues.speaker: Veroslava
dialogues.text: Thought you could infiltrate, did you? Too bad, I've seen right through you! Seize them!

dialogues.speaker: Veroslava
dialogues.text: Hmm? You look kind of unfamiliar. You're new around here, aren't you?

dialogues.speaker: Veroslava
dialogues.text: I'm saying this for your own good — don't go poking around the Design Bureau, especially not the second floor! Too much kuuvahki exposure can cause anything from headaches to full-on nausea. Don't say I didn't warn you!

dialogues.speaker: Veroslava
dialogues.text: Of course! Everyone who works in there gets an extra serving of Apple Cider. Think about it — if it weren't bad for your health, why would they bribe people with something that good?

dialogues.speaker: Veroslava
dialogues.text: Besides, I saw it with my own eyes in the Frostmoon Scions' territory! Their priestesses grew horns — on their heads! You seriously think that's normal?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I see... Thanks for the warning.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's awful! W—Will we turn into monsters too...?

dialogues.speaker: Veroslava
dialogues.text: *sigh* They always send the newbies in to do the risky stuff... Just be careful, and don't stay in there too long, alright?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm your long-time nemesis! Pleased to make your acquaintance!

dialogues.speaker: Veroslava
dialogues.text: Agh, it's an enemy assault... All units — attack!

dialogues.speaker: Veroslava
dialogues.text: I told you not to stay in there for too long! Why are you still running around like that? Aren't you even a little worried about the side effects from all that kuuvahki exposure?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Not at all. I'm not as weak as you are.

dialogues.speaker: Veroslava
dialogues.text: Huh!? Is "way too sassy" part of our recruitment profile nowadays...? W—Wait a sec — you're not one of the new batch of newbies! Y—You must be a spy! Everyone, seize them!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Excuse me, I think I've taken a wrong turn...

dialogues.speaker: Veroslava
dialogues.text: This is a military zone! If you've got business here, get on with it. If not, quit wandering around.
